verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook documents only per-artifact exports. Flashcards download as CSV, infographics as PNG, slide decks share as PDF, Audio Overviews download for offline playback, and notes export to Google Docs/Sheets. Nothing shows a bulk export of a whole account or notebook that would let a user take all their data and leave. Missing for 10: bulk or full-account export, export of sources and chat history, open-format export of notes (they go to Google Docs/Sheets), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Download your flashcards as a CSV file.
Present your deck instantly in Gemini Notebook or share it as a PDF.
Listen to Audio Overviews on the go and download them for offline playback.
You can export your notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets.
